features.clickfunnels: Conversation generates designed funnels and copy.
features.current: On the plans with AI writing (Studio and Scale), the guided setup's review step drafts the whole funnel from the store's own records: every new page's headline and introduction, copy only for blocks the page type has, the form's questions (subscribing always starts off), offers mapped to the store's own paid one-off products (nothing is created or priced) and follow-up emails saved switched off through the Email Studio. A sentence with a number no record carries is removed; a part only the creator knows is marked and keeps the page from being shown. Counted in writing jobs and reserved against the plan's AI budget before any request; pages are created hidden and the funnel disabled, so nothing is published. It does not design layouts or make pictures or videos. Not browser, load or live-provider evidence.

Every statement kept cites one of those sources and holds every number it states; labels and dates come from the store, never the model; the store's own uncertainty lines are always shown. It never searches the web (webSearch: false), so it does not propose markets beyond the store's records. Counted as one writing job. Not browser, load or live-provider evidence.

features.clickfunnels: Shared copies become independent; frameworks carry other resources.

It goes by file, by a share link (hashed at rest, revocable, expiring, capped by plan and by month) or, since 18 October 2026, as a copy into another store of the same account (the account's owner only; a teammate or anyone else's store is refused). Only words and shape go: never pictures, files, buyers, contacts, answers, reviews, prices, product, store or payment ids; a share to another creator also leaves out the sender's about text, videos, deadlines and quotes. Every read and write is inside the plans' priced monthly figures. Not browser, load or live-provider evidence.

features.clickfunnels: Conditional paths, goals, delays and split tests are indexed.
features.current: Any step can branch IF/ELSE (skip, end or jump to a later step), routes only go forward, and a goal (bought anything, got a product, carries a label) is checked before every step. A deterministic preview runs the job's own routing on a sample contact, typed in or read from the list, and sends, saves and writes nothing. Every way a run stops is listed beside the preview (lib/flow-stop-rules.ts). Waits are bounded: a wait with a known end is tried once at that end, anything else with a growing delay, at most 3 waits a run and 35 days a step, then the run stops with nothing done; the creator may try a held step again once a run. Waits and retries are in the per-run worst case (419 commands), with the runs a day lowered to keep each plan's cost. No split-test step beyond the existing A/B halves, no date trigger, no visual canvas. Not browser, load or live-provider evidence.
features.improvement: Add a date trigger and a split-test step, each within the same per-run worst case.

features.clickfunnels: Contact action history includes workflow progress.
features.current: Every run keeps each effect as attempted (written before it happens), then confirmed, failed or uncertain, plus skipped, goal and end, for 400 days; an uncertain outcome holds the run and is never retried by itself. A run's history counts attempted, confirmed, failed and uncertain separately; an attempt with no outcome, or one the creator marked as gone through, stays uncertain (lib/run-effects.ts). Bounded by construction: at most 62 events a run (a step that waits writes nothing; a creator's choice keeps the latest 20), at most 11,600 runs a workflow (the plan's runs a day for 400 days), each charged to the store's data room before it starts, and erased with a person, a workflow or a store. Not browser, load or live-provider evidence.
features.improvement: Show the four counts across a workflow's runs, not only per run, without a read per run.
